Each unit comes in three parallel forms: a **slide deck** used in the
lecture, a set of **notes** written as connected prose for reading on
their own, and a sheet of **exercises** with worked solutions. Units
that have accompanying code also have a page of **Jupyter notebooks**
that can be downloaded and run.

The notes carry interactive demonstrations -- collapsible panels with
sliders and animations -- that are not in the slides. They need
JavaScript, so they only work in the HTML version of the notes.

::: {.callout-note title="Draft under review"}
These materials are being revised. Comments on anything -- content,
ordering, notation, the interactive demos, typos in the captions -- are
welcome.
:::
